purpose: This table holds one cleaned row per airport sourced from the OurAirports bronze landing table, carrying identifiers, location, classification, and reference-link attributes for downstream geospatial and reference joins.
usage: Consumers should join on id as the primary key, filter on scheduled_service to distinguish airports with scheduled commercial service, and expect null values in icao_code, gps_code, local_code, home_link, wikipedia_link, municipality, elevation_ft, and keywords to mean the source data simply lacked that attribute, not that the row is invalid.
limitations: Sparsely populated reference columns are not backfilled: local_code is null in 63.7% of rows, home_link in 74.9%, keywords in 68.0%, icao_code in 13.7%, and elevation_ft in 3.7%; no duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0) so no dedupe logic was applied, and latitude/longitude precision was narrowed from the landed DECIMAL(38,9) to DECIMAL(9,6) based on observed sample precision.
